page_title: TOR 0-0 BOL | Torino v Bologna 03/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Simone Sozza has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Bologna keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
89' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
86' Here comes a substitution. Raoul Bellanova is given a rest as he is replaced by Valentino Lazaro (Torino).
86' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
82' Here is a change. Michel Aebischer is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Santiago Castro (Bologna).
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) for Joshua Zirkzee.
81' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
79' Adam Masina (Torino) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
79' Torino get a corner.
78' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antonio Sanabria.
77' Nikola Moro (Bologna) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Simone Sozza no option but to blow his whistle.
76' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:5.
73' A spell of possession for Torino in an attempt to control the game.
69' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Torino.
69' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Alexis Saelemaekers and he is replaced by Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
69' The manager makes a subsitution with Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) coming on for Dan Ndoye.

67' Ivan Ilic (Torino) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the left side of the goal, but Lukasz Skorupski is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
66' Bologna couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
66' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) touches the ball with his hand.
64' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:1.
60' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

60' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic!
59' It is time for a substitution. Nikola Moro (Bologna) is on for Giovanni Fabbian.
58' A long ball forward to Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is intercepted.
55' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
52' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Michel Aebischer (Bologna) for his blatant foul.
51' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
50' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) has tested the patience of referee Simone Sozza and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
50' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.

50' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simone Sozza with no other option than to blow for a foul.
49' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) spurns a great opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. The ball flies narrowly wide of the left post.

47' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Simone Sozza blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bologna was in an offside position.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' The game is interrupted now, Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
43' The foul by Antonio Sanabria (Torino) was seen by Simone Sozza who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
42' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
38' Bologna have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
36' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and it's Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
32' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Duvan Zapata (Torino), but the defence gets it clear.
28' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is being substituted because of an injury. Ivan Juric sends Karol Linetty on the pitch.
27' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
26' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) serves up a nice cross, but Lukasz Skorupski punches the ball away.
25' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
21' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
18' What a save! Duvan Zapata (Torino) hits a powerful volley towards goal after finding some space, but the goalkeeper denies his effort with a stunning save.
17' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
13' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
13' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick is awarded to Torino.
12' Decent spell from Torino here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in.
9' One of the players from Bologna times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
7' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) is penalised for holding. Simone Sozza signals a set piece. Bologna have a free kick.
6' Remo Freuler (Bologna) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
4' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
2' Some neat passing and movement from Bologna as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
1' The first half has started.
Bologna will kick the game off.
Simone Sozza was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
